patthana16.79:1.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho nabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana16.79:2.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nasanidassanasappaṭigho nanabhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
